title: Austin's Energy Grid, Lawsuits, & Economy
summary:
*   Officials held a private executive session to discuss significant ongoing lawsuits, including cases against Houston Lighting & Power and regarding a new water treatment plant, as well as land acquisition for the electric utility.
*   Robin Mick was appointed to the Economic Development Commission.
*   The City Manager updated officials on purchasing procedures and the city's financial health.
